Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Rochester New York hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 15 Rochester New York hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 3, trivago DEALS at 3, Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2 and Traveluro at 1. Taxes and fees at Rochester New York hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Hampton Inn & Suites Rochester/Victor to 14% at Home2 Suites by Hilton Rochester Greece. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
